title: 燕歌行（秋风萧瑟天气凉）
author: 曹丕
intro: On a cold autumn night a wife alone at home plays a sad tune, watches the Milky Way and asks the stars why lovers must be kept apart. It is the oldest complete poem in China written entirely in seven-character lines.
analysis: 这首诗用一位妻子的口吻，写她在秋夜思念远在北方（古代的燕地）的丈夫。开头先写秋景：秋风萧瑟，草木凋零，露水结成了霜，燕子和大雁都往南飞回去了——鸟都知道回家，人却还没回来。她猜丈夫也一定想家，可为什么还久久留在外地？接着写她自己：一个人守着空房，想着他，不知不觉泪水沾湿了衣裳。她拿起琴想排解忧愁，可弹出的是悲凉的“清商”调，歌声短促，唱不下去。夜深了，月光照到床前，银河向西转，夜还没有过完。最后她抬头看见天上的牵牛星和织女星隔着银河相望，忍不住问：你们犯了什么罪，要被隔在河的两边？这一问既是问星星，也是问自己的命运。全诗每句都押韵，一句七个字，是现存最早的完整七言诗，在诗歌史上很重要。
analysisEn: The poem speaks in the voice of a wife whose husband is far away in the north (the old region of Yan). It opens with autumn: a bleak wind, leaves falling, dew turning to frost, swallows and wild geese flying south. Even the birds know when to go home — but he hasn’t come back. She imagines he must be homesick too, so why does he stay away so long? Then the poem turns to her: alone in an empty room, thinking of him until tears wet her clothes before she notices. She picks up her zither to ease the pain, but what comes out is the mournful qingshang mode; her song breaks off, too short to finish. Moonlight reaches her bed, the Milky Way swings west, and the night still isn’t over. Finally she looks up at the Herd-boy and Weaver Girl stars, kept apart by the river of stars, and asks them what crime they committed to be separated like this — a question really aimed at her own fate. Every line rhymes and every line has seven characters: this is the earliest complete poem in China written that way, a milestone for the seven-character form that later Tang poets made famous.
background: Cao Pi (187–226), Cao Cao’s son, ended the Han dynasty and became the first emperor of Wei in 220. He was also a fine poet and wrote one of the first works of literary criticism in China. “Song of Yan” was an old yuefu tune title; Yan was the northern frontier region where many men were sent to serve.
pronunciation: 萧瑟 xiāo sè；慊慊 qiàn qiàn（心里不满足、怨恨的样子）；淹留 yān liú；茕茕 qióng qióng；援琴 yuán；夜未央 yāng；何辜 gū；衣裳 cháng（古诗中“裳”读 cháng，指下身的衣服，并与全诗押韵；今天口语“衣裳”读 yī shang）。网站按 cháng 注音。
version: 采用通行文本（《曹丕集》、古诗文网通行本），共十五句，句句押韵，网站两句一行，“贱妾……衣裳”三句合为一行。重要异文：《文选》作“群燕辞归鹄南翔”“念君客游多思肠”；“君何淹留寄他方”一作“何为淹留寄他方”。曹丕《燕歌行》共两首，这是第一首。

lines.zh: 秋风萧瑟天气凉，草木摇落露为霜。
lines.rhythm: 秋风/萧瑟/天气凉，草木/摇落/露为霜
lines.py: qiū fēng xiāo sè tiān qì liáng, cǎo mù yáo luò lù wéi shuāng
lines.lit: The autumn wind is bleak, the weather cold; grass and trees shake and fall, dew turns to frost.
lines.en: The autumn wind blows thin and cold; leaves shake loose, and dew turns into frost.

lines.zh: 群燕辞归雁南翔，念君客游思断肠。
lines.rhythm: 群燕/辞归/雁南翔，念君/客游/思断肠
lines.py: qún yàn cí guī yàn nán xiáng, niàn jūn kè yóu sī duàn cháng
lines.lit: Flocks of swallows take leave to return, wild geese fly south; thinking of you travelling far, my longing breaks my heart.
lines.en: Swallows leave for home, the geese fly south — and I think of you far away until my heart breaks.

lines.zh: 慊慊思归恋故乡，君何淹留寄他方？
lines.rhythm: 慊慊/思归/恋故乡，君何/淹留/寄他方
lines.py: qiàn qiàn sī guī liàn gù xiāng, jūn hé yān liú jì tā fāng
lines.lit: Restless, you must long to return and miss your home; why do you linger, lodging in another place?
lines.en: Surely you ache for home as well — so why do you linger in a stranger’s land?
lines.tts: 欠欠思归恋故乡，君何淹留寄他方？

lines.zh: 贱妾茕茕守空房，忧来思君不敢忘，不觉泪下沾衣裳。
lines.rhythm: 贱妾/茕茕/守空房，忧来/思君/不敢忘，不觉/泪下/沾衣裳
lines.py: jiàn qiè qióng qióng shǒu kōng fáng, yōu lái sī jūn bù gǎn wàng, bù jué lèi xià zhān yī cháng
lines.lit: I, your humble wife, alone and lonely, keep the empty room; when sorrow comes I think of you and dare not forget; unaware, tears fall and wet my clothes.
lines.en: Alone, I keep our empty room; when sadness comes I think of you — I could never forget — and tears soak my clothes before I know it.
lines.tts: 贱妾穷穷守空房，忧来思君不敢忘，不觉泪下沾衣常。

lines.zh: 援琴鸣弦发清商，短歌微吟不能长。
lines.rhythm: 援琴/鸣弦/发清商，短歌/微吟/不能长
lines.py: yuán qín míng xián fā qīng shāng, duǎn gē wēi yín bù néng cháng
lines.lit: I take the zither, sound the strings, and play the qingshang mode; a short song, softly sung, cannot go on long.
lines.en: I take up my zither and pluck a mournful tune, but my soft song breaks off before it’s done.

lines.zh: 明月皎皎照我床，星汉西流夜未央。
lines.rhythm: 明月/皎皎/照我床，星汉/西流/夜未央
lines.py: míng yuè jiǎo jiǎo zhào wǒ chuáng, xīng hàn xī liú yè wèi yāng
lines.lit: The bright moon, pure white, shines on my bed; the Milky Way flows west, the night is not yet over.
lines.en: White moonlight falls across my bed; the River of Stars drifts west, and still the night goes on.

lines.zh: 牵牛织女遥相望，尔独何辜限河梁？
lines.rhythm: 牵牛/织女/遥相望，尔独/何辜/限河梁
lines.py: qiān niú zhī nǚ yáo xiāng wàng, ěr dú hé gū xiàn hé liáng
lines.lit: The Herd-boy and the Weaver Girl gaze at each other from afar; what crime have you alone committed, to be barred by the river?
lines.en: Herd-boy and Weaver Girl gaze at each other across the sky — what did you do wrong, to be kept apart by that river?

words.en: bleak; (of wind) blowing coldly through trees
words.note: 现代书面语仍用，如“秋风萧瑟”“萧瑟的景象”。
指草木凋零，现代汉语少用。

words.en: to take leave and go home
words.note: 辞：告别，现代汉语有“告辞”“辞别”。

words.en: to live or travel far from home
words.note: 客：在外地的人，今天有“客居”“作客他乡”。
形容极度悲伤，书面语仍用。

words.en: to stay on for a long time
words.note: 古义，“淹”在这里是“久留”，不是“淹水”。

words.en: I (humble word used by a wife)
words.note: 古代女子的谦称，今天不用。
成语“茕茕孑立”，形容孤单无依。

words.en: to take hold of; to pick up
words.note: 古义“拿起”；今天常用义是“帮助”，如“支援”“援助”。
古代乐调名，声音清冷悲凉。
形容月光洁白，现代汉语有“皎洁”。

imagery.name: 秋风
imagery.zh: 开篇的秋风和满地落叶、白霜，营造出冷清悲凉的气氛，也暗示时间一年年过去。
imagery.en: The opening autumn wind, falling leaves and frost set a cold, sad mood — and show another year slipping by.

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 燕子、大雁都按时南归，反衬丈夫迟迟不回家。
imagery.en: Swallows and geese go home right on time — the husband does not.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 月光照到床前，说明她整夜睡不着，越看越孤单。
imagery.en: Moonlight on her bed shows she lies awake all night, lonelier the longer she looks.

imagery.name: 牵牛织女
imagery.zh: 被银河隔开的两颗星，就是她和丈夫的写照。
imagery.en: The two stars kept apart by the Milky Way are a picture of her and her husband.
